extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, and contributors interested in ancient philosophy and public-domain texts
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikisource page presenting a public-domain translation of Diogenes Laërtius's Lives of the Eminent Philosophers; intended as a digital edition and access point for readers and volunteers. The page lists volumes, books, copyright/public-domain status, and links for editing/proofreading.
